mara.activity: Wake slowly, drink water, check in with myself, and sit on the edge of the bed before standing.
mara.intention: Begin the day gently and notice my energy before errands.

mara.activity: Wash up, dress for the market, and gather the tote and wallet.
Have coffee and a small breakfast at the kitchen island, then collect my keys and reusable shopping bags.
mara.intention: Leave fed and prepared for the market and nursery.

mara.activity: Go to the farmers market and plant nursery for produce, herbs, and a few plants.
mara.intention: Complete the usual Saturday errands and enjoy being outside.

mara.activity: Return home, remove my shoes, place my keys in the open entryway, and set my field notebook on the living room sideboard countertop.
mara.intention: Arrive deliberately and put away the things I will need later.

mara.activity: Wash the market produce, put away what needs refrigeration, place the market herbs in a glass beside the sink, trim the houseplants, and reset the kitchen.
mara.intention: Follow the familiar Saturday reset and give the new plants a careful first look.

mara.activity: Make and eat a light lunch at the island, then rinse the plate and glass.
Change into comfortable clothes and pack the ceramics things in the tote.
mara.intention: Shift out of household and work mode before class.

mara.activity: Attend the ceramics class and work through the exercise without trying to make the piece client-perfect.
mara.intention: Practice being a beginner and enjoy the separate social world of the class.

mara.activity: Return home, make tea, and read or sketch garden ideas in the living room.
mara.intention: Let the concentration from class soften into a quieter afternoon.

mara.activity: Prepare a simple early dinner at the island and eat while the light is still good.
mara.intention: Feed myself before Julian's later service rather than waiting for an uncertain shared meal.

mara.activity: Rinse the dishes, wipe the island, water the trimmed plants as needed, and leave the ceramics things together for the next class.
mara.intention: Close the practical loop without turning the evening into more work.

mara.activity: Take a quiet shower, change into sleep clothes, and spend some unstructured time reading in the living room.
mara.intention: Stay easy and available to myself while Julian is at the restaurant.

mara.activity: Wash up, brush my teeth, and put my phone on its charger.
Get into bed, place my reading glasses on top of my nightstand, read a few pages, and turn out the light.
mara.intention: Rest without waiting up for a predictable evening together.

julian.activity: Wake beside Mara, drink water, and lie still for a few minutes while checking how I feel and whether she is resting comfortably.
julian.intention: Start gently and avoid rushing into the long workday.

julian.activity: Take a hot shower, brush my teeth, and dress in work trousers, a restaurant shirt, wool socks, and kitchen clogs.
julian.intention: Wake up fully and get ready for prep.

julian.activity: Make coffee and a small breakfast, carry them to the kitchen island, and eat quietly while listening to a few minutes of piano music.
julian.intention: Have something steady in me before deliveries and prep.

julian.activity: Pack my backpack, fill the thermos, collect my keys from the piano's middle shelf, and check the restaurant notebook and menu folder.
julian.intention: Leave with the essentials and keep the new schedule from making me careless.

julian.activity: Bring the thermos into the kitchen and set it beside the sink, put my backpack near the island, and leave the restaurant notebook on the island with receipts tucked inside.
julian.intention: Stage everything by the door without losing my usual notebook and receipt habit.

julian.activity: Handle restaurant prep, deliveries, ordering checks, and kitchen management.
julian.intention: Get the kitchen ready, receive the deliveries, and keep the team organized.

julian.activity: Eat a small portion of leftovers or yogurt and fruit, drink water, and sit quietly in the main bedroom to reset.
julian.intention: Recover before the later service rather than spend the whole gap working.

julian.activity: Review service notes, change into a clean chef jacket and apron, and send Mara a short practical message about the uncertain evening schedule.
julian.intention: Recalibrate our shared time without making her responsible for solving my schedule.

julian.activity: Travel back to the restaurant, check the final station setup, and prepare for service.
julian.intention: Arrive early enough to absorb surprises before guests arrive.

julian.activity: Work dinner service and closing duties, managing the later, less predictable schedule and supporting the kitchen team.
julian.intention: Lead calmly through service and close thoroughly even if the evening runs late.

julian.activity: Return home, bring the thermos into the kitchen and set it beside the sink, put my backpack near the island, and drop my wallet and earplugs on the living room coffee table.
julian.intention: Come home in a simple sequence and leave nonessential tidying for tomorrow.

julian.activity: Take a hot shower, brush my teeth, and change into sleep clothes without turning on the television.
julian.intention: Wash the service off and move directly toward sleep.

julian.activity: Drink water, put my phone on its charger, and leave my wallet and earplugs where they are for the morning.
julian.intention: Finish the day with as little decision-making as possible.

julian.activity: Get into bed beside Mara and settle into sleep.
julian.intention: Rest before the next demanding restaurant day.
